def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]

    # Defensive: if instance uses contiguous ids, all good; otherwise demands/matrix are still indexable by node id.
    cust_set = set(customers)

    # Helpers
    def route_load(route):
        return sum(demands[i] for i in route)

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]]
        for k in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[k]][route[k + 1]]
        c += matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        return c

    def try_two_opt(route):
        # Deterministic best-improving 2-opt (capacity unchanged)
        n = len(route)
        if n < 4:
            return route
        best = route
        best_delta = 0
        best_i = best_j = -1
        # Evaluate all swaps; keep first best delta to stay deterministic and small
        for i in range(0, n - 3):
            a = best[i]
            b = best[i + 1]
            dab = matrix[a][b]
            for j in range(i + 2, n - 1):
                c = best[j]
                d = best[j + 1]
                # Removing edges (a,b) and (c,d), adding (a,c) and (b,d)
                delta = (matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]) - (dab + matrix[c][d])
                if delta < best_delta:
                    best_delta = delta
                    best_i, best_j = i, j
                    if best_delta < -1e-12:
                        # continue to find potentially better (best-improving)
                        pass
        if best_i != -1:
            i, j = best_i, best_j
            new_route = best[:i + 1] + list(reversed(best[i + 1:j + 1])) + best[j + 1:]
            return new_route
        return route
